title: Cursor feature panels
description: A stack of full-width paper panels 88px apart, each a narrow centred text column (a 22px title in ink, a 22px description in 60% ink, an orange arrow link, optionally a mono install-command chip with a round copy button) beside a 680px-tall media frame inset 17px from the panel's edges. The media alternates right, left, right… On phones the text sits on top and the media below.
notes: media frames are 680px tall at every width; empty ones show a glow-to-muted wash
the copy button is visual: wire your own clipboard handler if you need one
